stem: Moonrise was at 14:23 on 7 April 2025 and at 15:17 on 8 April 2025. Which statement best explains this delay of 54 minutes?

The Moon spins once on its own axis in exactly a day
The Moon moves along its orbit as the Earth turns
The Sun moves ahead of the Moon in the sky each day

stem: A student says, 'The Moon's phases happen because the Earth's shadow falls on it.' Why is this explanation incorrect?
options: The Earth's shadow reaches the Moon only at new Moon
The Moon is too far away for any shadow to reach it
Phases come from changing Sun-Earth-Moon positions

stem: Lunar eclipses can happen only on full Moon days, yet most full Moon days have no eclipse. What is the reason?

The Earth's shadow exists only during some months
The Moon revolves faster in some months than in others
The Moon's orbit is tilted a little to Earth's orbit
explanation: Correct option: (D). 12 hours 19 minutes

stem: Why do the seasons not stay in the same months from year to year in a purely lunar calendar?

Its months vary in length from about 20 to 40 days

stem: In a purely lunar calendar, a festival falls in peak summer this year. Roughly how many years later will the same festival fall about six months away in the cycle of seasons, near peak winter?

About 16 years
About 33 years
